title: limonium rumicifolium
intro: Limonium rumicifolium, commonly known as sea lavender, is a perennial succulent plant native to the Mediterranean region. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Limonium rumicifolium include its ability to act as a vulnerary, astringent, and diuretic, which may help to promote wound healing, reduce excessive fluid retention, and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide additional health benefits when consumed or applied topically.
